verdict.rationale: Omarchy documents built-in AI agent onboarding (first-boot agent setup, sign-in), ships OpenCode and Claude Code as default agent harnesses, provides skills so the agent can build apps/themes, and even routes crash diagnostics to the agent — all first-party but consistent and specific. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration specifically of the AI-agent delegation workflow (community evidence covers other aspects of Omarchy, not this feature).
